package com.statmaker.app

/** The normal UAT build reads exact forecasts from the real App-Ready database. */
internal object DirectForecastContract {
    const val EXACT_MODEL = "betting-v2-joint-count-v4"
    const val LEGACY_MODEL = "betting-v2-monotone-matchup-scenarios-v3"

    fun table(isUat: Boolean): String =
        if (isUat) "prepared_betting_v4_forecasts" else "prepared_betting_v2_forecasts"

    fun accepts(model: String, runs: Int, isUat: Boolean): Boolean =
        if (isUat) model == EXACT_MODEL && runs == 0
        else model == LEGACY_MODEL && runs == 10_000

    fun description(model: String, runs: Int): String =
        if (model == EXACT_MODEL) "Exact probabilities · prior-window calibration"
        else "$runs runs · uncalibrated probability"
}

package com.statmaker.app
fun main() {
    check(DirectForecastContract.table(true) == "prepared_betting_v4_forecasts")
    check(DirectForecastContract.table(false) == "prepared_betting_v2_forecasts")
    check(DirectForecastContract.accepts(DirectForecastContract.EXACT_MODEL, 0, true))
    check(!DirectForecastContract.accepts(DirectForecastContract.EXACT_MODEL, 10000, true))
    check(!DirectForecastContract.accepts(DirectForecastContract.LEGACY_MODEL, 10000, true))
    check(DirectForecastContract.accepts(DirectForecastContract.LEGACY_MODEL, 10000, false))
    check(!DirectForecastContract.accepts(DirectForecastContract.EXACT_MODEL, 0, false))
    check(DirectForecastContract.description(DirectForecastContract.EXACT_MODEL, 0).contains("prior-window calibration"))
    println("PASS exact UAT reader contract: 8 assertions")
}
